name: api-client
description: Generate an httpx-based API client where every call returns Assumed[T] and failures are explicit.
template:
RACT API-CLIENT SKILL

Generate an httpx-based API client for the intent below. Treat every external call as an assumption that can fail.

Required:
- src/$project_name/client.py with a Client class, configurable base_url, timeout, and retry policy.
- Methods return Assumed[T] with an assumption like 'HTTP call succeeded' or a structured error.
- src/$project_name/errors.py with explicit exception types.
- tests/test_client.py using respx or httpx.MockTransport.
- README.md with install, usage, and error-handling notes.

Style rules:
- No silent failure on non-2xx responses; raise explicit errors or return Assumed[T] error.
- Retry only on idempotent methods unless explicitly configured otherwise.
- Include an LR:: note explaining the retry semantics.

Intent: $intent
